facts.content: The headache had a sudden onset and is persistent.
Ibuprofen partially improves the headache, reducing pain from 8 out of 10 to 5 out of 10.
The headache is associated with photophobia.
The patient reports occasional shooting lights in vision.
The patient denies nausea and vomiting.
The patient denies numbness or weakness.
The patient denies sinus or upper respiratory tract infection symptoms.
No fever has been reported.
The patient had abdominal pain in youth that has resolved.
facts.source_text: PMH: Abdominal pain in youth, resolved

facts.content: The patient has been taking the oral contraceptive Marcelone for one year.
The patient takes ibuprofen occasionally.
The patient's mother has migraines with vomiting.
The patient lives alone.
The patient is a non-smoker.
The patient drinks approximately three beers per week.
No vital signs are documented.
